messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P1: bridge-proxy.retry-throttle fired for service 'bridge-proxy' (region: us-west-2). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: Automatic page dispatched to oncall. Escalation policy: bridge-ops.

mike: ack
mike: I'm taking this — oncall. Starting initial triage.

mike: quick summary: 5xx spike from bridge-proxy, queue depth up ~6x, lots of client retries observed. Suspect retry storm after recent client deploy.

tanya: any confirmed customer impact?

mike: yes — embedding requests timeout, p95 latency jumped and some 503s. Dashboards:
```
bridge_proxy_5xx_rate: 480/min
bridge_queue_depth: 312 (baseline ~50)
dedicated_pool_p95_latency_ms: 2300
```

raj: I'm nearby, joining bridge in 2m. Can you drop the runbook link?

mike: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bridge-retry

mike: mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit aggressive client retriers at the edge 2) scale dedicated-pool-bridge +3 replicas 3) identify offending client versions.

ops-bot: Scaling action: increased replicas for dedicated-pool-bridge by 3 in us-west-2. (cmd: autoscaler scale --pool dedicated-pool-bridge --add 3)

pagerduty-bot: mike acknowledged INC12345 at 7300001235

mike: applied a temporary client retry guard via ingress rule (rewrote Retry-After header -> forced exponential backoff). Watching metrics.

sre-ellen: looping in product for customer-facing comms. Which customers are hitting errors?

mike: looks like a small set of high-throughput enterprise users sending large batch embedding requests. One customer (acme-corp) saw ~40% failures for ~20 minutes.

raj: taking over in ~8m — will need handoff: state = scaled + retry-guard applied, identifying client_version=2.4.0 as primary suspect.

mike: handoff notes: reproduction harness attached to runbook, logs show repeated upstream 502s with many retry attempts:
```
[2026-03-15T03:20:01Z] bridge-proxy ERROR fetch: upstream 502 retry loop client_id=acme-corp batch=large attempts=12
[2026-03-15T03:20:02Z] bridge-proxy ERROR fetch: upstream 502 retry loop client_id=acme-corp batch=large attempts=13
```

tanya: can we pin rule to reject >5 retries/min per client until client hotfix?

raj: applying rate-limit now. Command: 
```
kubectl patch config bridge-proxy --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/ratelimit","value":{"retries_per_min":5}}]'
```

ops-bot: patch applied to bridge-proxy-config in us-west-2.

mike: metric update: 5xx rate dropping, queue depth trending down.

pagerduty-bot: raj acknowledged takeover of INC12345 at 7300001350

raj: I'm going to coordinate a controlled rollback/patch with product for client_version=2.4.0. ETA for hotfix rollout ~45m.

sre-ellen: please post impacted customer list to #customer-liaison and draft an interim status message.

mike: posted interim status to #status-updates and pinged product/CS.

ops-bot: Autoscaler re-enabled after stabilization.

raj: metrics look stabilized. queue_depth back to ~baseline, p95 latency improving.

mike: propose 30m quiet window then close if no regressions.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 state: acknowledged -> in_progress.

incident-bot: Monitoring quiet window (30m).

mike: 30m passed, no recurrence. Closing incident. Root cause: client deploy removed jitter from retry logic leading to synchronized retries -> overloaded bridge. Mitigations: temporary retry-rate guards, scaled pool, customer notified. Follow-ups: postmortem + add canary guard for client deploys, add retry-rate guardrail in bridge, improve runbook checklist.

tanya: thanks for the rapid response everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 closed at 7300001610
